title: AaLLM: An End-to-End Analog Circuit Design Framework from Topology Generation to Sizing Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.13472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog circuit design is a time-consuming, iterative process in a nonlinear and high-dimensional design space that relies heavily on expert intuition. Among recent developments, LLMs have introduced a promising approach by bringing natural language reasoning to circuit design tasks. The majority of conventional LLM-based approaches provide fragmented solutions that focus either only on sizing or topology generation. These methods require adding specific technical knowledge manually, which is inefficient and prone to hallucinations during circuit sizing. Moreover, the inherent trade-off in meeting different specs makes current approaches iterative and tedious. Another shortcoming is the inability to create innovative topologies, which may lead to sub-optimal designs due to reliance on conventional topologies. translated_title: AaLLM：一种从拓扑生成到尺寸确定的全流程模拟电路设计框架，基于大型语言模型
translated_abstract: 模拟电路设计是一个耗时且迭代的过程，其设计空间是非线性和高维的，严重依赖专家直觉。在近期发展中，大型语言模型通过将自然语言推理引入电路设计任务，提供了一种有前景的方法。大多数传统的基于LLM的方法提供碎片化的解决方案，要么仅关注尺寸确定，要么仅关注拓扑生成。这些方法需要手动添加特定技术知识，效率低下且在电路尺寸确定过程中容易产生幻觉。此外，满足不同规格的固有权衡使当前方法变得迭代且繁琐。另一个缺点是缺乏创新能力来生成新颖拓扑，这可能因依赖传统拓扑而导致次优设计。在本文中，我们提出AaLLM，一个开源的全流程多代理LLM工作流，它接收用户规格作为输入，并输出最终结果。
tldr: AaLLM提出了一种全流程多代理LLM工作流，从用户规格直接生成模拟电路拓扑和尺寸，克服了传统方法碎片化、依赖手动知识和缺乏创新拓扑的局限。
en_tdlr: AaLLM proposes an end-to-end multi-agent LLM workflow that directly generates analog circuit topologies and sizing from user specs, overcoming the limitations of fragmented, manual-knowledge-dependent, and innovation-lacking conventional approaches.
